title: Kid Howard's resemblance to Chris Kelly
summary: Howard started as a drummer and then played trumpet like Kelly; later he copied Armstrong.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Chris Kelly, the blues trumpeter and his band

blocks.x: Somebody told me that the kid Howard plays it a good deal like Chris or tries to.
When he first started playing trumpet, Howard, used to play exactly like Chris Kelly.
Some people told me in The Careless Love he plays at some of those same chords. Uh huh.

He'd be able to play just like Chris Kelly. But, you're right by and Margetts, Amit, Payton, Lewis and other different fellas, I guess that would spoil his lick. Hmm. Howard was a pretty good trumpet player.
Did the kid Howard ever play drums with you when you were playing with Chris?
Yeah, we started. Somebody told me he started as a drummer.

That's right, he was a pretty good drummer. I was surprised there. One night, uh, we was in Queens. So he came round by my house. I was living on 10 Phillips Street. And the fella named, we call him Bozoo. He said, alright, you ain't doing nothing like that.
I'm gonna want you to go down the bridge way with me.
You know what you playing, Connor?
I said, yeah, come on. He got in the truck and went down that way. I was surprised. I'm telling you, he was playing just like Chris Kelly. Yeah. Mm-hmm. Yeah.
He did the job nice. Well, did Chris ever play a lot of high notes?
Some time. He won't to. Mm-mm. Not too much. Look like... You can make some higher notes, but... He plays down.
Well, it seems, uh, the reason why I asked that, it seems like, uh, Howard plays quite a little, uh, of high notes now.
I'm telling you, he changed in playing. Try to play like Armstrong now, I guess. Yeah. Well, I'm just impressed.
They all do now, I said.
Mm-hmm. I think that's what kind of threw them back, I know. You tell me he's coming back again, but I know he had to lose all of his.
